description: Look up an Italian public administration or public-service operator by 11-digit codice fiscale in IndicePA (AgID). Use when an agent must verify a public-sector counterparty, find its official PEC (certified email) addresses, or confirm it exists before e-invoicing. Costs $0.005 in USDC (or 0.005 EURC) on Base via x402, charged on every paid call (also not found, malformed codice fiscale or IndicePA unavailable): check the 11 digits first. Unpaid calls return the x402 v2 payment requirements (isError, not charged); pay per call with an x402 MCP client (payment in params._meta["x402/payment"], e.g. @x402/mcp). Docs: https://github.com/yeick010/italycheck
name: lookup_italian_pa
